defaultPrompt: Redesign this deck as a VC. Redesign the complete uploaded company deck for a VC/investor audience, preserving source-backed facts, numerical meaning and brand identity. Choose the narrative, slide order, copy and visual composition from the content. Strengthen evidence hierarchy and readability; do not invent missing evidence or a funding request. No user-written prompt or predefined style family is required.
narrativeObjectives: Understand the company from the uploaded deck first: what the product is, who it serves, what pain matters, and why the company could matter to investors.
Extract the brand feel from the deck's existing language and visuals, then redesign in a sharper investor direction without losing the company's identity.
Apply the default VC redesign purpose to the whole deck without requiring the user to supply instructions.
Make the story scannable in one pass for VC partners and investment committees.
Turn raw source material into a cleaner problem -> solution -> traction -> market -> team -> ask progression when evidence allows.
Highlight risks, proof gaps, and diligence follow-ups instead of hiding them.
